selected_origins.instruction: Please sulfonylate the primary amine with a propylsulfonyl group.
Please methylate the NH nitrogen of the benzimidazole ring.
Please alkylate the benzimidazole NH with a 2-thienylmethyl group.
Please acylate the primary amine with a 5-(methylsulfonyl)thiophene-2-carbonyl group.
Please benzylate the secondary amine nitrogen of the piperidine ring.
Please remove the benzyl protecting group from the phenolic oxygen.
Please remove the carboxybenzyl (Cbz) protecting group from the primary amine on the pyrrolidine ring.
Please remove the benzyl protecting group from the phenol.
Please remove the carboxybenzyl (Cbz) protecting group from the amine.
Please remove the tert-butoxycarbonyl (Boc) protecting group from the piperidine nitrogen.
Please substitute the bromine atom on the 2-fluorophenyl ring with a 2-oxopyrrolidin-1-yl group.
Please alkylate the phenolic hydroxyl group with a 2-(dimethylamino)ethyl group and remove the 2-(trimethylsilyl)ethoxymethyl (SEM) protecting group from the purine ring.
Please substitute the bromine atom with a 3-oxopiperazin-1-yl group.
Please substitute the chloride of the acyl chloride group with a 2-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)ethylamino group.
Please substitute the chlorine atom on the 1,3,5-triazine ring with a bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amino group.
